cues.zh: 呃……负责解决这些问题的人是 Harley 的 CEO，Matt Levitich。他干着全世界最难的工作。Honda 做这事是一回事，但 Harley 呢，他们对一切小而便宜的东西一向装作看不见，

cues.en: it's no wonder Levitich described the project as a long march.
cues.zh: 难怪 Levitich 把这个项目称为一次长征。

cues.en: The name borrowed from that famous retreat
cues.zh: 这名字借自那场著名的撤退，

cues.en: where the Red Army fled with 100,000
cues.zh: 红军带着十万人出走，

cues.en: soldiers and made it home with fewer than 7,000.
cues.zh: 到家时不足七千。

cues.en: What fraction of Harley Davidson will survive?
cues.zh: Harley Davidson会有多大比例存活下来？

cues.en: Levitich was just sacked with 11,000,000 retirement gifts. How many salaries will that erase?
cues.zh: Levitich刚被解雇，拿了1100万美元的退休礼。这能抵掉多少份薪水？

cues.en: Will HD disappear as a brand?
cues.zh: HD作为一个品牌会消失吗？

cues.en: Probably not. As a motorcycle,
cues.zh: 大概不会。作为摩托车品牌，

cues.en: maybe.
cues.zh: 也许吧。

cues.en: It's forty years too late for these long paths of retreat, these now paths of doom.
cues.zh: 这些漫长的撤退之路，如今成了毁灭之路，已经晚了四十年。

cues.en: I think Harley's best hope is to accept that their good run has waned into a good night. Focus back on cruisers and rage with your customers against the dying of the light, And there is hope. And HD's replacement CEO is a rogue who took command, immediately deemphasized
cues.zh: 我认为Harley最好的希望是接受他们的好日子已经过去，变成了美好的夜晚。重新聚焦巡航车，和你的客户一起愤怒地对抗光明的消逝，而且还有希望。HD的接任CEO是个叛逆者，一上任就立即淡化

cues.en: more roads, then axed his own salary until the gang finds its rigors.
cues.zh: 更多道路，然后砍掉自己的薪水，直到团队找到严酷的纪律。

cues.en: If the easy riders showed up now, that's exactly what they'd do.
cues.zh: 如果轻松骑手们现在出现，那正是他们会做的事。

cues.en: This is our highway,
cues.zh: 这是我们的公路，

cues.en: and we're gonna defend our highway.
cues.zh: 我们要捍卫我们的公路。

cues.en: Wrong, Jack.
cues.zh: 错了，Jack。

cues.en: Why do you think I don't wear the colors, Jack? Why do you think I ride alone?
cues.zh: 你觉得我为什么不穿队服，Jack？你觉得我为什么独自骑行？

cues.en: Because you don't know about it anymore.
cues.zh: 因为你不再懂这些了。

cues.en: But I think you all ought to get back on your bikes and go out and ride on the highway until you remember what riding's all about.
cues.zh: 但我觉得你们都应该回到自行车上，出去在公路上骑行，直到你们想起骑行到底是为了什么。

cues.en: K pop
cues.zh: K-pop

cues.en: takes after his mom.
cues.zh: 随他妈妈。
